outcomes.note: phi = Pearson correlation between two binary leg outcomes. 0 means the parlay's independence assumption holds; anything else means a same-game parlay is mispriced relative to its own legs.

signals.interpretation: A spread edge and a total edge are close to independent, so combining them in one parlay genuinely diversifies risk.

limitations: Only game-level markets are measured here; player-prop outcomes need player-week data that is not available in this sandbox, so prop-to-prop correlations are published as UNVERIFIED rather than estimated.
Correlations are measured on closing lines, which is the fairest post-hoc benchmark but is not the price every bettor actually got.
